record.stdout:
usage: python -m textstats [-h] [--keep-bom] [--lines START:END] INPUT

Count CRLF/CR/LF lines and Unicode whitespace words in UTF-8 input.

positional arguments:
  INPUT              named UTF-8 file or - for binary stdin (use ./- for a
                     file named -; -- before dash-prefixed names)

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --keep-bom         retain a leading Unicode BOM as ordinary content
  --lines START:END  select inclusive positive ASCII decimal logical lines
                     (one range only)
